thread.title: UBS Thinks Apple’s Stock is Going to Recover

author: Austin Angelo
title: UBS Thinks Apple’s Stock is Going to Recover
text:
In a report released today, Nicolas Gaudois from UBS maintained a Buy rating on Apple ( AAPL – Research Report ), with a price target of $180 . The company’s shares opened today at $150, close to its 52-week low of $142.
According to TipRanks.com , Gaudois is ranked #1434 out of 5141 analysts.
Currently, the analyst consensus on Apple is a Moderate Buy with an average price target of $178.57, which is a 19.0% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 2, RBC Capital also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $220 price target.
Apple’s market cap is currently $724.1B and has a P/E ratio of 12.64. The company has a Price to Book ratio of 6.66.
